figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0) gross_cents,ROUND(100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) margin_pct,b.target target_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0),2) achievement_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC
